body.purpose: Reading text and field labels, always sans.

data.purpose: Measured values in mono with tabular digits.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono table heads and section labels.

shadows.name: drag-lift
shadows.purpose: Step card while being dragged. No shadows at rest.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Button state changes; reduced-motion collapses all durations to 0.01ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen, violet-to-indigo gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #b664ff, #444ce7); color: #fff; font-family: 'Noto Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #444ce7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Flat muted-fill button for ordinary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: #e8e8e8; color: #141414; font-family: 'Noto Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #dedede; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #444ce7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Variant Tile
components.description: Solid colour square standing for one ad variant.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; margin-right: 6px; background: #444ce7; color: #fff; font-family: 'Noto Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-tile-b { background: #ffce3a; color: #141414; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Mono label with a square mark; filled mint means live.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #59fda0; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Always-dark 56px bar with gradient underline on the active link.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 56px; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; padding: 0 24px; background: #141414; border-bottom: 1px solid #2e2e35; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; color: #a9adba; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #f8fafc; } .ds-nav a.ds-nav-on { color: #f8fafc; } .ds-nav a.ds-nav-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #b664ff, #444ce7); }

components.name: Run-of-Show Row
components.description: Rail row: index, summary, duration, hairline between.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5rem 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; padding: 8px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d6d6d6; font-size: 14px; color: #141414; } .ds-row span:first-child, .ds-row span:last-child { font-family: 'Noto Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row:hover { background: #e8e8e8; }

components.name: Image Slot
components.description: Hue-free mat holding an ad image.
components.css: .ds-slot { border: 1px solid #d6d6d6; } .ds-mat { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: #e2e2e2; color: #5c5c5c; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: A study is a timed sequence, and the admin draws it that way: a numbered rail of steps with their durations, and each ad variant a solid flat colour square that follows it across every screen. The shell is a near-black frame with square corners and a monospace voice for anything measured; the canvas inside it is plain grey so that the ad images are the only colour that is not a brand signal.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes of the canvas (light default, dark); the shell is dark in both.
Square corners everywhere; borders, not shadows, separate surfaces.
Light-weight grotesk headings, mono buttons and data.
Violet-to-indigo gradient marks the one primary action; mint means live or done.

rules.name: The Hue-Free Canvas Rule
rules.body: Canvas greys and the image mat carry no tint, in either theme. Ad colours must be judged against neutral. Never warm, cool or brand-tint them.

rules.name: The Shell Is Always Dark Rule
rules.body: Top bar, study bar, login and studies header are dark in both themes. Put them under .shell; do not hand-colour inside.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The violet-to-indigo gradient is for the primary action and the active-nav underline only. Mint is only for live or done.

rules.name: The Measured-Value Rule
rules.body: Anything measured is mono with tabular digits; anything a reader reads is sans.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. Depth appears only while dragging or in overlays.

rules.name: The Aurora Boundary Rule
rules.body: The aurora field appears only on the login screen and the studies header band.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: No rounded corners, pills or circles on surfaces, buttons, tiles or badges.

dos: Do keep canvas, mats and image surrounds hue-free grey.
Do put new dark-bar surfaces inside `.shell`.
Do set every measured value in `.data`.
Do use the variant tile colour for a variant wherever it appears.
Do use mint only for live or done.
donts: Don't put the aurora anywhere but the login screen and studies header band.
Don't tint the canvas or image mat "to warm it up".
Don't use more than one gradient button per screen.
Don't stack white rounded cards on lilac.
Don't load fonts or assets from a CDN.
